notes.title: New demo available!
notes.notes: [p]Hi folks![/p][p]Tiny Monster Haven was showcased yesterday in this year's Monster Taming Direct, a showcase of many amazing upcoming monster taming games. To celebrate this achievement we've released a brand new demo! You can download it from the game's Steam page or navigate to it directly: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757320/Tiny_Monster_Haven_Demo/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p]We've implemented a ton of new stuff in this demo build:   [/p][list][*][p]Reworked the game to fit snug at the bottom/side of your screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters now do a lot more in your Haven! Depending on their element they help out in different ways. Water monsters will water your crops, Fire monsters will boost cooking times, Plant monsters can harvest crops and carry them to the brand new storage boxes, and more!   [/p][/*][*][p]Monster Essence has been reworked to no longer be monster-specific, instead you have one pool of Essence and you can spend it in the egg shop as you want. The egg shop will list available monster eggs as well as how they'll benefit your Haven.[/p][/*][*][p]With the new layout we've also tweaked which wild monsters appear: when you purchase new land you'll unlock more decorations, more eggs in the egg shop and new wild monsters will start appearing![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A tournament arena has been added, which you'll be able to purchase once you have strong enough monsters. In the demo you can take on the Rookie tournament and battle NPC tamers in 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 battles and win useful items that will improve your monster's battle performance!  [/p][/*][/list][p]Monsters will now be [b]much[/b] more active and useful in your Haven![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638331/3cb36d9009a248eabd19dcc1ef48f5650f738847.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The reworked egg shop gives a useful preview of what abilities a monster brings to your Haven.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638331/4ddab89f4fd7afc89625cad2cc4090fe21b71f78.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you play the demo please do share your thoughts! I'm very open to feedback and there's a lot of ways we can expand things before full release, so feel free to help steer the game's direction.[/p][p]Please consider leaving a review on the demo's Steam page if you like the game, this will help boost the game's visibility![/p][p][/p][p]More updates to come![/p]

notes.title: Demo Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's been very exciting to get the demo in the hands of players!

Based on initial feedback we've already been hard at work adding in a first set of QoL improvements, as well as minor revisions to some game systems:
[list]
[*]Some wild monsters will now only appear at certain times of the day or in certain seasons!
[*]Players can now sell surplus crops, food and even monsters for extra coins.
[*]Revised the egg system to now require Monster Essence instead of coins! Collect a monster's Essence by defeating them in wild battles.
[*]You can now recover ingredients from the cookpot if the cooking hasn't started yet.
[*]The racing minigame has been improved. Players can now also use SPACE bar to boost their monster as it jumps over obstacles.
[/list]

You wouldn't really sell your Chardinal would you??
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638331/268f79202b64b0c759434cb2b822907a00d63cf3.png[/img]
Monster eggs now require Essence instead of coins. And the cookpot's ingredients can be recovered.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638331/ecbb90de938bc588922d6af5130dd4710a510a6b.png[/img]

We're also fixed a few bugs, most notably:
[list]
[*]Fixed the corn being mislabeled as wheat.
[*]Fixed a case where game transparency didn't work (instead players would get a black screen as background). This issue would arise if players started up the game and, before the game was fully initialised, the player swapped to a different program.
[/list]

More updates to come!

We welcome anyone to join in on the discussion and provide their suggestions and feedback!
